method: AST imports plus literal module/path references; conservative package initializers; dynamic imports, data paths and subprocess arguments require manual migration review. Outside closure means candidate, not safe to delete. Bare test-module imports resolve against tests/. File-level closure includes incidental historical packaging references and is not a minimal function-level dependency list.
untracked_preservation_policy: No untracked files approved for deletion; inventory sizes do not prove duplication or backup.

current_consolidation.scope_note: Merged current control and disturbance workflows. Lower-level mathematical, actuator and historical artifact helpers remain where required; historical entrypoints and comparison tests are not yet removed.
